knowledge:
- key_parameters: Input=A list of ExpressionSet objects representing different omics blocks ;; center/scale/weight=Preprocessing options where center and scale are applied independently per block, and weight is applied across blocks to prevent larger datasets from dominating ;; method=The component analysis algorithm to use ("DISCOSCA", "JIVE", or "O2PLS") ;; Rcommon/Rspecific=The number of common and distinctive components to extract ;; referenceFeatures=The baseline feature list (e.g., genes) used to map other omics types in clustering ;; mapping=A bioMap object containing the feature-to-feature mapping between different omics types ;; dataTypes=A character vector specifying the data type ('count' or 'continuous') for each input block in omicsNPC ;; combMethods=Combining functions for NPC ('Fisher', 'Liptak', 'Tippett') ;; numPerms=The number of permutations to perform for NPC (typically starting at 1000)
- alternatives: pcaMethods or missMDA can be used for cross-validation of individual PCA results since this is not natively supported in STATegRa's modelSelection yet ;; limma is used internally by omicsNPC to compute initial statistics ;; hclust or kmeans are standard R functions recommended to perform the final clustering step after STATegRa computes the weighted distance matrices
- when_to_use: Use component analysis when you want to identify shared and unique patterns of variation across multiple omics datasets on the same samples. Use omics clustering when you want to group features (e.g., genes and miRNAs) across different omics types using a known mapping. Use omicsNPC when you want to identify genes that are differentially expressed or associated with an outcome across multiple omics modalities holistically.
- pitfalls: Weighting between blocks must be applied during preprocessing if the datasets have different numbers of features, otherwise larger blocks will dominate the analysis ;; Variance Associated for each Component (VAF) cannot be calculated for O2PLS because its components are not orthogonal ;; OmicsClustering should not be used if the mapping between features involves less than 15-25% of the reference set of features ;; omicsNPC assumes that the last column of each design matrix contains the factor of interest to be assessed

workflows.name: omics_component_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify common and distinctive variation across multiple omics datasets using DISCO-SCA, JIVE, or O2PLS.
workflows.stages: 1. Create ExpressionSet objects using createOmicsExpressionSet ;; 2. Perform model selection to find the optimal number of common and distinctive components using modelSelection ;; 3. Run component analysis using omicsCompAnalysis with the chosen method ("DISCOSCA", "JIVE", or "O2PLS") ;; 4. Retrieve scores, loadings, and VAF using getScores, getLoadings, and getVAF ;; 5. Plot VAF using plotVAF and results using plotRes
workflows.code:
B1 <- createOmicsExpressionSet(Data=Block1.PCA, pData=ed.PCA,
                               pDataDescr=c("classname"))
B2 <- createOmicsExpressionSet(Data=Block2.PCA, pData=ed.PCA, 
                               pDataDescr=c("classname"))
ms <- modelSelection(Input=list(B1, B2), Rmax=3, fac.sel="single%",
                     varthreshold=0.03, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE, 
                     weight=TRUE, plot_common=FALSE, plot_dist=FALSE)
discoRes <- omicsCompAnalysis(Input=list(B1, B2), Names=c("expr", "mirna"),
                              method="DISCOSCA", Rcommon=2, Rspecific=c(2, 2),
                              center=TRUE, scale=TRUE, weight=TRUE)
jiveRes <- omicsCompAnalysis(Input=list(B1, B2), Names=c("expr", "mirna"),
                             method="JIVE", Rcommon=2, Rspecific=c(2, 2),
                             center=TRUE, scale=TRUE, weight=TRUE)
o2plsRes <- omicsCompAnalysis(Input=list(B1, B2),Names=c("expr", "mirna"),
                              method="O2PLS", Rcommon=2, Rspecific=c(2, 2),
                              center=TRUE, scale=TRUE, weight=TRUE)
getScores(discoRes, part="common")
getScores(discoRes, part="distinctive", block="1")
getScores(discoRes, part="distinctive", block="2")
getVAF(discoRes)
plotVAF(discoRes)
plotRes(object=discoRes, comps=c(1, 2), what="scores", type="common",
        combined=FALSE, block=NULL, color="classname", shape=NULL, labels=NULL,
        background=TRUE, palette=NULL, pointSize=4, labelSize=NULL,
        axisSize=NULL, titleSize=NULL)

workflows.name: omics_clustering
workflows.intent: Cluster features across different omics types by mapping surrogate features to reference features and computing weighted distances.
input: mapdata (matrix containing mapping between miRNA and mRNA)
workflows.stages: 1. Create ExpressionSet objects using createOmicsExpressionSet ;; 2. Compute reference feature distance matrix using bioDistclass ;; 3. Create a mapping object using bioMap ;; 4. Compute surrogate feature distances mapped to reference features using bioDist ;; 5. Define a weight matrix and compute weighted combinations of distances using bioDistW ;; 6. Plot the feature distance of weighted combinations using bioDistWPlot ;; 7. Find and plot associated features using bioDistFeature and bioDistFeaturePlot
workflows.code:
mRNA.ds <- createOmicsExpressionSet(Data=Block1, pData=ed, pDataDescr=c("classname"))
miRNA.ds <- createOmicsExpressionSet(Data=Block2, pData=ed, pDataDescr=c("classname"))
bioDistmRNA <- bioDistclass(name="mRNAbymRNA",
                            distance=cor(t(exprs(mRNA.ds)),
                                         method="spearman"),
                            map.name="id",
                            map.metadata=list(),
                            params=list())
MAP.SYMBOL <- bioMap(name = "Symbol-miRNA",
                     metadata = list(type_v1="Gene", type_v2="miRNA",
                                     source_database="targetscan.Hs.eg.db",
                                     data_extraction="July2014"),
                     map=mapdata)
bioDistmiRNA <- bioDist(referenceFeatures=rownames(Block1),     
                        reference="Var1",
                        mapping=MAP.SYMBOL,
                        surrogateData=miRNA.ds, 
                        referenceData=mRNA.ds, 
                        maxitems=2,
                        selectionRule="sd",
                        expfac=NULL,
                        aggregation="sum",
                        distance="spearman",
                        noMappingDist=0,
                        filtering=NULL,
                        name="mRNAbymiRNA")
bioDistList <- list(bioDistmRNA, bioDistmiRNA)
sample.weights <- matrix(0, 4, 2)
sample.weights[, 1] <- c(0, 0.33, 0.67, 1)
sample.weights[, 2] <- c(1, 0.67, 0.33, 0)
bioDistWList <- bioDistW(referenceFeatures=rownames(Block1),
                         bioDistList=bioDistList,
                         weights=sample.weights)
bioDistWPlot(referenceFeatures=rownames(Block1),
             listDistW=bioDistWList,
             method.cor="spearman")
IDH1.F <- bioDistFeature(Feature="IDH1",
                         listDistW=bioDistWList,
                         threshold.cor=0.7)
bioDistFeaturePlot(data=IDH1.F)

workflows.name: holistic_differential_expression
workflows.intent: Identify genes that are differentially expressed or associated with an outcome across multiple omics modalities using Non-Parametric Combination (NPC).
input: TCGA_BRCA_Data (list of ExpressionSet objects for different modalities, e.g., RNAseq, RNAseqV2, Microarray)
workflows.stages: 1. Define data types for each modality (e.g., "count", "continuous") ;; 2. Specify combining methods (e.g., "Fisher", "Liptak", "Tippett") ;; 3. Set permutation parameters (numPerms, numCores, verbose) ;; 4. Run the holistic association analysis using omicsNPC
workflows.code:
dataTypes <- c("count", "count", "continuous")
combMethods <- c("Fisher", "Liptak", "Tippett")
numPerms <- 1000
numCores <- 1
verbose <- TRUE
results <- omicsNPC(dataInput=TCGA_BRCA_Data, dataTypes=dataTypes,
                    combMethods=combMethods, numPerms=numPerms,
                    numCores=numCores, verbose=verbose)
